title: Biomechanical Effect of Different Biodentine Placement Levels in Regenerative Endodontic Procedures: A Finite Element Analysis and Fracture Resistance Study
html: The placement level of hydraulic calcium silicate materials during regenerative endodontic procedures (REPs) may affect biomechanical performance of immature permanent teeth. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of different Biodentine placement levels on biomechanical performance of immature permanent teeth treated with REPs using three-dimensional finite element analysis (FEA) validated by fracture resistance testing.
